verses.en: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, which are named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel came!
verses.pt: Ai dos que vivem sossegados em Sião, e dos que estão seguros no monte de Samária, dos homens notáveis da principal das nações, e aos quais vem a casa de Israel!
verses.en_web: Woe to those who are at ease in Zion, and to those who are secure on the mountain of Samaria, the notable men of the chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel come!
verses.en_bbe: Sorrow to those who are resting in comfort in Zion, and to those who have no fear of danger in the mountain of Samaria, the noted men of the chief of the nations, to whom the people of Israel come!

verses.en: Pass ye unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great: then go down to Gath of the Philistines: be they better than these kingdoms? or their border greater than your border?
verses.pt: Passai a Calné, e vede; e dali ide à grande Hamate; depois descei a Gate dos filisteus; porventura são melhores que estes reinos? ou são maiores os seus termos do que os vossos termos?
verses.en_web: Go to Calneh, and see; and from there go to Hamath the great; then go down to Gath of the Philistines. are they better than these kingdoms? or is their border greater than your border?
verses.en_bbe: Go on to Calneh and see; and from there go to Hamath the great; then go down to Gath of the Philistines: are you better than these kingdoms? or is your land wider than theirs?

verses.en: Ye that put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;
verses.pt: ó vós que afastais o dia mau e fazeis que se aproxime o assento da violência.
verses.en_web: Those who put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;
verses.en_bbe: You who put far away the evil day, causing the rule of the violent to come near;

verses.en: That lie upon beds of ivory, and stretch themselves upon their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the midst of the stall;
verses.pt: Ai dos que dormem em camas de marfim, e se estendem sobre os seus leitos, e comem os cordeiros tirados do rebanho, e os bezerros do meio do curral;
verses.en_web: Who lie on beds of ivory, and stretch themselves on their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the middle of the stall;
verses.en_bbe: Who are resting on beds of ivory, stretched out on soft seats, feasting on lambs from the flock and young oxen from the cattle-house;

verses.en: That chant to the sound of the viol, and invent to themselves instruments of musick, like David;
verses.pt: que garganteiam ao som da lira, e inventam para si instrumentos músicos, assim como Davi;
verses.en_web: who strum on the strings of a harp; who invent for themselves instruments of music, like David;
verses.en_bbe: Making foolish songs to the sound of corded instruments, and designing for themselves instruments of music, like David;

verses.en: That drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief ointments: but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.
verses.pt: que bebem vinho em taças, e se ungem com o mais excelente óleo; mas não se afligem por causa da ruína de José!
verses.en_web: who drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the best oils; but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.
verses.en_bbe: Drinking wine in basins, rubbing themselves with the best oils; but they have no grief for the destruction of Joseph.

verses.en: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.
verses.pt: Portanto agora irão em cativeiro entre os primeiros que forem cativos; e cessarão os festins dos banqueteadores.
verses.en_web: Therefore they will now go captive with the first who go captive; and the feasting and lounging will end.
verses.en_bbe: So now they will go away prisoners with the first of those who are made prisoners, and the loud cry of those who were stretched out will come to an end.

verses.en: The Lord GOD hath sworn by himself, saith the LORD the God of hosts, I abhor the excellency of Jacob, and hate his palaces: therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein.
verses.pt: Jurou o Senhor Deus por si mesmo, diz o Senhor Deus dos exércitos: Abomino a soberba de Jacó, e odeio os seus palácios; por isso entregarei a cidade e tudo o que nela há.
verses.en_web: “The Lord Yahweh has sworn by himself,” says Yahweh, the God of Armies: “I abhor the pride of Jacob, and detest his fortresses. Therefore I will deliver up the city with all that is in it.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord God has taken an oath by himself, says the Lord, the God of armies: the pride of Jacob is disgusting to me, and I have hate for his great houses: so I will give up the town with everything in it.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.
verses.pt: E se ficarem de resto dez homens numa casa, morrerão.
verses.en_web: It will happen, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.
verses.en_bbe: Then it will come about that if there are still ten men in a house, death will overtake them.

verses.en: And a man’s uncle shall take him up, and he that burneth him, to bring out the bones out of the house, and shall say unto him that is by the sides of the house, Is there yet any with thee? and he shall say, No. Then shall he say, Hold thy tongue: for we may not make mention of the name of the LORD.
verses.pt: Quando o parente de alguém, aquele que o queima, o tomar para levar-lhe os ossos para fora da casa, e disser ao que estiver no mais interior da casa: Está ainda alguém contigo? e este responder: Ninguém; então lhe dirá ele: Cala-te, porque não devemos fazer menção do nome do Senhor.
verses.en_web: “When a man’s relative carries him, even he who burns him, to bring bodies out of the house, and asks him who is in the innermost parts of the house, ‘Is there yet any with you?’ And he says, ‘No;’ then he will say, ‘Hush! Indeed we must not mention Yahweh’s name.’
verses.en_bbe: And when a man's relation, even the one who is responsible for burning his body, lifting him up to take his bones out of the house, says to him who is in the inmost part of the house, Is there still anyone with you? and he says, No; then he will say, Keep quiet, for the name of the Lord may not be named.

verses.en: For, behold, the LORD commandeth, and he will smite the great house with breaches, and the little house with clefts.
verses.pt: Pois eis que o Senhor ordena, e a casa grande será despedaçada, e a casa pequena reduzida a fragmentos.
verses.en_web: “For, behold, Yahweh commands, and the great house will be smashed to pieces, and the little house into bits.
verses.en_bbe: For see, at the order of the Lord the great house will be full of cracks and the little house will be broken.

verses.en: Shall horses run upon the rock? will one plow there with oxen? for ye have turned judgment into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock:
verses.pt: Acaso correrão cavalos pelos rochedos? Lavrar-se-á ali com bois? Mas vós haveis tornado o juízo em fel, e o fruto da justiça em alosna;
verses.en_web: Do horses run on the rocky crags? Does one plow there with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison, and the fruit of righteousness into bitterness;
verses.en_bbe: Is it possible for horses to go running on the rock? may the sea be ploughed with oxen? for the right to be turned by you into poison, and the fruit of righteousness into a bitter plant?

verses.en: Ye which rejoice in a thing of nought, which say, Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?
verses.pt: vós que vos alegrais de nada, vós que dizeis: Não nos temos nós tornado poderosos por nossa própria força?
verses.en_web: you who rejoice in a thing of nothing, who say, ‘Haven’t we taken for ourselves horns by our own strength?’
verses.en_bbe: You whose joy is in a thing of no value, who say, Have we not taken for ourselves horns by the strength which is ours?

verses.en: But, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Israel, saith the LORD the God of hosts; and they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hemath unto the river of the wilderness.
verses.pt: Pois eis que eu levantarei contra vós, ó casa de Israel, uma nação, diz o Senhor Deus dos exércitos, e ela vos oprimirá, desde a entrada de Hamate até o ribeiro da Arabá.
verses.en_web: For, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, house of Israel,” says Yahweh, the God of Armies; “and they will afflict you from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of the Arabah.”
verses.en_bbe: For see, I will send against you a nation, O Israel, says the Lord, the God of armies, ruling you cruelly from the way into Hamath as far as the stream of the Arabah.
